title: Page 8
lines: 「你……」倚谰怔怔地看着他，感觉体内的内力正似流水般逝去。
玄灵抽剑而出之时，顺便一拳重击在他的头上直接撂倒他，云时林间又再次恢复了宁静。
他赶时间地弯身提起地上的两人，抬首一看，天际已铺上层层瑰霞，正是逢魔时刻。
血色迷茫的夕霞下，容易扬拳自枝头跃下，暗藏着无比巨力的拳头，眼看就要击中树下躲藏之人，来者在察觉疾速的掌风之际，已侧身朝旁一滚，适时躲过那记砸出一处大坑的重拳。
一记银光穿透林间茂盛的林叶，在流士正忙着闪躲容易追上来的一拳，利箭已划过他的耳畔削去了一块肉，流士火冒三丈地唤出两柄弯刀，一刀砍向死黏着他不放的容易，另一刀则甩向躲在林间向他施以暗袭之人。
月穹赶在那柄弯刀就要令容易毁容前，眼捷手快地扯过容易，心狠手辣的她，朝流士撒出一片密密麻麻的金针，他忙挥刀将那片针群扫落，可数枚漏网之针仍是刺进了他的身子里。
一种类似被吞噬啃咬的剧痛，分别自他的伤处传来，他拼上内力疾速往后飞跃，在确定已拉远一段安全距离后，不敢置信地问。
「你在针上淬毒？」他还真是小看了为达目的不择手段的黄金门，为能达成任务，再下流再歹毒的事，他们都做得出来。
月穹睐他一眼，「剧毒哟。」
早在中针后就已蓄着内力的他，听了立即运上内力打算逼出毒针，没注意到他脚下的草地上，初春鲜嫩的草叶正无风轻揺，下一刻，一双玉手自地底破土而出，牢牢擒握住他的双脚，其力道之大，甚至握碎了他右脚的腿骨，当下令他眼中凶光大盛，刀尖一转就要将弯刀刺入土中，一只掌心已无声无息覆在他的头顶上。
玄灵如同一抹幽夜中的鬼魅出现在流士的身后，当他明白这是个猎捕的圈套时，玄灵已用上七成的内力，将五指陷入他的首级之中，随后一把将流士扔至一旁，看他瞠张着眼瞳，在紫色的火光中化为林间的一缕尘灰。
以汗巾拭净手中的血迹后，玄灵弯身将还窝在土里的再莱给拉出来，将灰头土脸的她交给月穹去打理。
容易甩着酸疼的胳膊抱怨，「三师兄，你不是说目标只有三个？」
「是三个。」
「那么那些魂役又是打哪儿冒出来的？」什么只有三个？他们接连着十日待在这座大山里头，追了再追、杀了又杀，偏就是没完没了，永远都还有下一个魂役在等着他们。
「问问不就知道了？」身后背着一把弓的傅衡，边说边走向玄灵摆置战利品的大树。
被玄灵一路提过来的倚谰，手中抱着听说天生病弱的司徒霜倚坐在一棵大树下，在他们联手杀了最难搞定的流士之后，他缓缓睁开眼晴。
「那些魂役自然是我们许出来的。」抬首望着疲累都明显写在脸上的五人，倚谰抿着唇，对他们浅浅轻笑。
「魂役……能许愿？」容易愣住了那么一会儿。
傅衡则是听得嗤之以鼻，「别说笑了，魂役连此生的生命都属于魂主，哪有什么资格可以许愿？」
「诸位不信也罢，不过，我家主上要我转告你们一句。」倚谰将手中的司徒霜拖抱至身上一手环紧他，再别有深意地看向他们。
「有屁快放！」没耐心的容易可不欣赏他的摆谱。
「天下三道，亦不在他的眼下。」
「什么？」
没待他们反应过来，众目暌睽下，倚谰自袖中职出一张类似魂纸的纸张，将之撕开后，他整个人就遭一阵来得诡异的疾风卷起，眨眼间，他的身影已出现在林间的另一头。
月穹拦下急着想去追人的两个师弟。
「都别追了，这事有古怪。」
「有什么古怪？」容易可不愿辛苦一整日的成果就这么白白跑了。
「我认为，方才那个倚谰所带走的司徒霜，早就死了。」怪不得她老觉得有哪儿不对劲。
「四师姐，你没弄错？」天真的再莱歪着脑袋，一直以来根深柢固的魂主死，魂役亦亡的想法，就在她的这么一句话中轻易的被推翻了。
副业是大夫的月穹挫败地搔着发，「没呼吸没心跳，脸上的尸斑亦不是假的，不是死人是什么？」忙活了那么久，得到的却是这个突如其来的诡异终曲，这令他们每个人都十分难以接受，更不敢相信倚谰竟在他们的眼下就这么跑了。
「三师兄？」众人不约而同地问向主事者。
玄灵眼中的眸光分外冷凝，「先回师门将此事禀告大师兄。」远在数国之外，身为云取宫宫主的野风，此刻的心情也很复杂。
听闻三国将起兵，将矛头对准了云取宫而来，野风先后修书数封予曾经接受过云取宫帮助的各国基层百姓，仔细说明云取宫遭难的原由，很快的，她想要的回音，便在各国领地中四处掲起。
受过恩惠们的百姓们，不需要野风派人鼓动喧闹，他们在得知云取宫的消息后，先是在最短的时间内将消息传遍各国国内，再以药神的信仰为号召，汇集数量庞大的百姓向君主们施压。
都因云取宫的乐善好施，且不求回报，因此他们所引发的民意浪潮，出乎各国主事者们想象的还要强烈，令原本只想保持观望态度，不想管闲事的他们，最终在百姓的要求下，不得不出手干预。在野风的令下，关上门缩躲在云取宫的众人，与包围了云取宫外山脉的三国联军僵持了那么久后，在这一日，他们终于盼到了打破这局面的好消息。
「如何？」野风忐忑不安地问着叶慈。
叶慈收起手中自京都递来的国主亲信，「各国来使，已于昨日抵达青麟国京都，准备与国主商议该如何保护云取宫。」她深吁口气，「太好了……」殿外不远处，朔方兴冲冲地跑向他们，并兴奋地扯开了嗓门。
「宫主，原国大使来了！」没想到第一个突破重围，向神宫展示善意的，竟是距离神宫最远的原国。
「快请。」
一改在极山道观上狠狈示人的印象，出使至此地的斐然，已再次恢复了原国公子的翩翩风采，让见过他一面的叶慈差点就认不出来。
「怎么是你？」他不是个道士吗？
斐然揺着手中的折扇，一派风流潇洒。
「我乃原国断皇爷三弟，今次，我是代表原国皇帝而来的。」反正这里没有清罡真人，他爱怎么拽就怎么拽。
「久仰然公子大名。」见过不少世面的野风，也听过然公子这个响当当的名号。
他优雅的行礼，「宫主。」
「我就长话短说了。」野风不拖泥带水地问：「贵国可欲与云取宫结盟？」
「云取宫乃药神遗留于世间的恩泽，我原国自是愿结成永盟之好。」这种好事，小皇帝求都求不来呢，光是一个继承了药神法典的宫主，就足够让小皇帝跑第一个来这驰援了。野风神色严肃地向他拱手，「我代云取宫多谢贵国皇帝。」
「宫主客气。」斐然正色地道：「相信神宫之危，很快就能解除，万望宫主还得为天下百姓多多保重。」
「承你贵言。」与野风签完盟约，被送至迎客楼的斐然，很快就沉醉在终于解禁开荤的食肉喜悦中了，但野风则仍不能放下心。
「西苑国的使者还没到吗？」光只有原国一国，无法凸显出云取宫的重要性，她要的是天下诸国的反应。
content_en:
"You..." Yi Zhen looked at him blankly, feeling that the internal energy in his body was passing away like running water.
When Xuan Ling drew his sword, he punched him hard on the head and knocked him down. The silence in the forest was restored again.
In a hurry, he bent down and lifted up the two people on the ground. When he looked up, he saw that the sky was covered with layers of rose clouds. It was the moment of encountering the devil.
Under the bloody and confused sunset, Yi Yi jumped down from the branch with his fist raised, hiding his extremely powerful fist. He was about to hit the person hiding under the tree. When the person noticed the rapid wind of his palm, he rolled sideways and just in time to avoid the heavy punch that made a big hole.
A streak of silver light penetrated the lush leaves in the forest. While Liu Shi was busy dodging the punch that was coming after him, the sharp arrow had already sliced ​​off a piece of flesh on his ear. Liu Shi called out two scimitars in a rage, one slashing at Yong Yi who was clinging to him, and the other knife throwing it at the person hiding in the forest who was attacking him secretly.
Yue Qiong rushed to the point where the scimitar was about to disfigure Yi Yi, and pulled Yi Yi over with quick eyes and quick hands. She was cruel and ruthless, and scattered a dense mass of golden needles towards Liu Shi. He hurriedly swept away the needles with his knife, but several needles that slipped through the net were still pierced into his body.
A severe pain, similar to being swallowed and bitten, came from his wounds. He used his inner strength to leap back quickly. After making sure that he had pulled away to a safe distance, he asked in disbelief.
"Are you quenching the poison on the needle?" He really underestimated the Golden Gate who would do anything to achieve their goals. In order to achieve their mission, they would do any despicable or vicious thing.
Yue Qiong glanced at him and said, "It's extremely poisonous."
He had already accumulated internal strength after receiving the needle. After hearing this, he immediately used his internal strength to force out the poisonous needle. He did not notice that on the grass under his feet, the fresh and tender grass blades in early spring were gently blowing in the wind. The next moment, a pair of jade hands emerged from the ground. Grasping his feet firmly, the force was so strong that it even shattered the leg bones of his right foot. A fierce light flashed in his eyes. He turned the tip of the knife and was about to pierce the scimitar into the soil. A palm silently covered the top of his head.
Xuan Ling appeared behind Liu Shi like a ghost in the dark night. When he understood that this was a hunting trap, Xuan Ling had used 70% of his internal strength to sink his five fingers into his head, then threw Liu Shi aside and watched as his eyes widened and turned into a wisp of dust in the forest in the purple firelight.
After wiping the blood on his hands with a sweat towel, Xuan Ling bent over and pulled out Zai Lai, who was still nestled in the soil, and handed her disgraced face to Yue Qiong to take care of.
It's easy to throw away your sore arms and complain, "Third Senior Brother, didn't you say there are only three targets?"
"It's three."
"Then where did those soul servants come from?" Why only three? They stayed in this mountain for ten consecutive days, chasing and chasing, killing and killing, but it was endless. There was always the next soul servant waiting for them.
"Can't you just ask?" Fu Heng, carrying a bow behind him, said as he walked towards the big tree where Xuan Ling placed the trophies.
Yi Chen, who was carried all the way by Xuan Ling, sat under a big tree holding Situ Shuang, who was said to be naturally sick and weak. After they joined forces to kill the most difficult Liu Shi, he slowly opened his eyes.
"Those soul services were naturally promised to us." Looking up at the five people whose fatigue was clearly written on their faces, Yi Chen pursed her lips and smiled lightly at them.
"Soul Service...can you make a wish?" Yi Yi was stunned for a while.
Fu Heng sneered at this, "Don't be ridiculous, the soul slave and even his life in this life belong to the soul master, so how can he have the qualifications to make a wish?"
"It's okay if you don't believe it, but my master wants me to tell you something." Yi Zhen dragged Situ Shuang in his hand to his body and hugged him tightly, then looked at them meaningfully.
"If you fart, let it go!" The impatient Yi Yi didn't appreciate his showmanship.
"The three realms of the world are not under his eyes."
"What?"
Before they could react, in front of everyone, Yi Chen took out a piece of paper similar to soul paper from his sleeve. After tearing it open, his whole body was swept up by a strange gust of wind. In the blink of an eye, his figure appeared on the other side of the forest.
Yue Qiong stopped the two junior brothers who were eager to chase someone.
"Stop chasing me. This is weird."
"What's weird?" Yi Yi didn't want the results of a whole day's hard work to go to waste.
"I think that Situ Shuang, who was taken away by Yi Jian just now, is already dead." No wonder she always felt that something was wrong.
"Fourth Senior Sister, are you not mistaken?" The innocent Zai Lai tilted her head. The long-held belief that the soul master dies and the soul slave also dies was easily overturned by her words.
Yue Qiong, who works as a doctor on the side, scratched his hair in frustration, "There is no breathing or heartbeat, and the corpse spots on the face are not fake. What is it if it's not a dead person?" After working for so long, what they got was this sudden and strange finale. This was very difficult for each of them to accept, and they couldn't believe that Yi Chen ran away like this before their eyes.
"Third Senior Brother?" Everyone asked the person in charge in unison.
The look in Xuan Ling's eyes was extremely cold, "Go back to the master first and report this matter to senior brother." Several countries away, Yefeng, the master of Yundori Palace, also had a complicated mood at the moment.
After hearing that the generals of the Three Kingdoms had raised their troops and targeted the Cloud Palace, Yefeng wrote several letters to the grassroots people in various countries who had received help from the Cloud Palace, explaining in detail the reasons for the disaster in the Cloud Palace. Soon, the response she wanted was spread throughout the territories of various countries.
The people who had received the favor did not need Yefeng to send people to stir up noise. After they learned the news about Yuntori Palace, they first spread the news throughout the countries in the shortest possible time, and then used the belief in the Medicine God as a rallying cry to gather a large number of people to put pressure on the monarchs.
It was all because of Untori Palace's charity without asking for anything in return. Therefore, the wave of public opinion they aroused was stronger than the imagination of the leaders of various countries. They originally just wanted to maintain a wait-and-see attitude and did not want to meddle in other people's business. In the end, they had to intervene at the request of the people. Under Yefeng's order, the people who closed the door and hid in Yuntori Palace had been in a stalemate with the Allied Forces of the Three Kingdoms who surrounded the mountains outside Yuntori Palace for so long. On this day, they finally got the good news to break the situation.
"How?" Yefeng asked Ye Ci anxiously.
Ye Ci put away the confidant of the King who was handed over from Kyoto in his hand, "Envoys from various countries arrived in Kyoto of Qinglin Kingdom yesterday, and are ready to discuss with the King how to protect Yundori Palace." She took a deep breath, "That's great..." Not far outside the palace, Shuofang ran towards them excitedly, and raised his voice excitedly.
"Palace Master, the ambassador of the original country is here!" Unexpectedly, the first one to break through the siege and show goodwill to the shrine was the farthest from the shrine.
"Please quickly."
一改在极山道观上狠狈示人的印象，出使至此地的斐然，已再次恢复了原国公子的翩翩风采，让见过他一面的叶慈差点就认不出来。
"Why are you?" Isn't he a Taoist priest?
Fei Ran held the folding fan in his hand, looking elegant and unrestrained.
"I am the third brother of Emperor Duan of the Yuan Kingdom. This time, I am here on behalf of the Emperor of the Yuan Kingdom." Anyway, there is no real Qinggang here, so he can pull him as much as he likes.
"I have long admired the name of Young Master Ran." Ye Feng, who had seen a lot of the world, had also heard of the famous name of Young Master Ran.
He saluted gracefully, "Palace Master."
"I'll keep the story short." Yefeng asked in a nonchalant manner: "Does your country want to form an alliance with Untori Palace?"
"Yuntori Palace is a blessing left by the God of Medicine in the world. Our country is naturally willing to form an eternal alliance." This kind of good thing can't be asked for by the little emperor. Just a palace master who inherited the code of the God of Medicine is enough for the little emperor to be the first to come here to help. Yefeng handed over to him with a serious expression, "I will take the palace on behalf of Yun to thank your emperor."
"Palace Master, you're welcome." Fei Ran said sternly, "I believe that the crisis in the palace will be resolved soon. Palace Master Wanwang must take care of the people of the world."
"I appreciate your words." After signing the contract with Ye Feng, Fei Ran was sent to the guest building. He soon became immersed in the joy of finally being able to eat meat, but Ye Feng still couldn't let go.
"Hasn't the envoy from Xiyuan Kingdom arrived yet?" Only the Yuan Kingdom alone could not highlight the importance of Untori Palace. What she wanted was the reaction of all the countries in the world.
